E-7-Y is a 특정활동(E-7) sub-code, and the decree's F-5-1 item covers D-7 to E-7 with no sub-code carve-out, so its years count toward F-2-99 and F-5-1 like any other E-7 years. The fix should reuse the F-5-1 note that the non-degree E-7 codes (E-7-2/3/4) already carry, translated into all four languages, not the generic 5-year note: these youths are mostly school-leavers. Simulated in a scratch copy: a reader aged 22 who answered edu 1 sees F-5-1 blocked on edu and F-2-99 open. E-7-Y still has no in-edges, so today this only matters when the reader picks E-7-Y as their current visa. The primary text was not re-fetched this session.

verdicts.reason: The repo claim is true. E-7-S1's how.en reads 'A job with a very high income, regardless of degree, experience or occupation.': it gives no income threshold and wrongly implies no occupation is excluded. E-7-S1 is the negative-list high-income route: 3× the previous year's per-capita GNI, any job except simple labour, jobs against public morals and other jobs closed to foreigners, with no degree or experience requirement. That matches what I know and the other research files; the manual text could not be re-fetched this session. The fix's 'about 140M KRW in 2026' is wrong: 3× the 2025 GNI that KIS uses from 2026-04-01 (₩52.416M, the YAML's gni:) is about ₩157.2M, or about ₩149.9M if the reported E-7 exception (2024 GNI until 2027-03) holds. So drop the KRW figure. rules.js now accepts a visa-level `income` rule (shown as a 'later' tag, never blocking), so `income: {gni: 3}` can also be added.
verdicts.correctedFix:
# data/visamap.yaml, visas.E-7-S1.how: replace en (the ru, uz and uz-cyrl strings must be re-translated to match):
    how: {en: 'A job paying at least 3× Korea''s per-capita GNI, in any occupation except simple labour, jobs against public morals and other jobs closed to foreigners; no degree or experience requirement.', ru: <translate>, uz: <translate>, uz-cyrl: <translate>}
# Do NOT write 'about 140M KRW'. 3× GNI is ≈₩157.2M on the 2025 GNI (₩52.416M) and ≈₩149.9M if E-7 keeps the 2024 GNI (₩49.955M) until 2027-03.
# Optional, with the new income schema: add `income: {gni: 3}` to visas.E-7-S1. The engine will show ≈₩157.2M, which may be ≈₩7.4M too high if the E-7 GNI exception applies.

verdicts.reason: The repo part is true: E-7-S1 and E-7-S2 carry the same F-2-7 note, 'After 1+ year of work: points waived, KIIP level 3 needed.' (with lang kiip 3). The legal point, that an E-7-S2 holder must still score 60+ on the E-7-S2 test at the F-2-7 change, rests only on a manual sentence reproduced by a blog. I could not reach the manual or any primary source this session (WebFetch DNS failure on every host, shared WebSearch budget used up), and my own knowledge of this detail is weak. The current note is not plainly wrong, since what is waived is the 80-point F-2-7 table. If a primary source confirms the quote, a low-risk wording would be: 'After 1+ year on E-7-S2, still meeting its 60-point test: the F-2-7 80-point test is waived; KIIP level 3 needed.'

verdicts.reason: The repo claim is true: E-7-Y's F-2-R entry is bare, so the step shows F-2-R's general how ('… KIIP 3 or TOPIK 3, and 5 years in a depopulating area'). The repo's own manual-derived data confirms that chapter 38 has a separate 지역특화 우수인재(F-2-R) section for Korea-raised youth, and that extensions on that track check only the residence requirement. The '4 years', 'on E-7-Y or D-10' and 'shorter qualifying period' parts have no source (the finding says so itself), so they must go. A move's note replaces the visa's how on screen (visamap.js howTo: step.note || visa.how), so the note must stand on its own.
verdicts.correctedFix:
# data/visamap.yaml, visas.E-7-Y.next: replace the bare `- F-2-R` with (the ru, uz and uz-cyrl strings must be translated):
    - to: F-2-R
      note: {en: 'Youth raised in Korea have their own F-2-R track (KIS stay manual, chapter 38), whose conditions may differ from the general regional-talent rules; once on it, extensions check only that you still live in the area. Ask immigration (1345) for the current conditions.', ru: <translate>, uz: <translate>, uz-cyrl: <translate>}
# Do not state a year count or 'E-7-Y or D-10'; neither is sourced.
